scientific_integrity: The general-alphabet conclusion follows from an exact finite proof and a symbolic multiplicity reduction, not from extrapolating the four-letter experiment.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only at word length eight. Uses a complete finite 3,850-word reduced search after a proved even-multiplicity lemma; every alphabet size is covered by order-preserving embeddings. No statement for larger lengths; historical priority in unindexed literature is not established.
title: Complete sharp length-eight unclustered Burrows–Wheeler images
